title: Cap. IX Arg. 11 Sol: baptism seals as Arminians allow — original-sin remission for every infant; actual-sin remission and regeneration for believers when adult
pass_a_gloss: And we can say no less than the Arminians themselves, that Baptism seals unto every infant the remission of original sin, by which alone infant age is held; seals also the remission of actual sins prepared in the blood of Christ unto those repenting and believing, when they have come unto adult age, and have fallen into actual sins; seals also regeneration and renovation to be effected from the incorruptible seed of the word and of the Spirit in all believers, after they have lived unto an age capable of the Divine word.
pass_b_english: And we can say no less than the Arminians themselves. Baptism seals to every infant the remission of original sin, by which alone infant age is held. It also seals remission of actual sins prepared in Christ's blood for those who repent and believe when they come to adulthood and fall into actual sins. It seals, further, regeneration and renewal wrought from the incorruptible seed of word and Spirit in all believers, once they live to an age capable of the divine word.
source_text: Et dicere possumus non minus quam ipsi Arminiani, Baptismum obsignare cuivis infanti originalis peccati remissionem, quo solo tenetur aetas infantilis; obsignare etiam actualium peccatorum remissionem in Christi sanguine paratam resipiscentibus et credentibus, cum ad aetatem adultam pervenerint, et in actualia inciderint; obsignare etiam regenerationem et innovationem ex incorruptibili semine verbi Spiritusque efficiendam in omnibus credentibus, postquam ad aetatem verbi Divini capacem vixerint.
